key_concepts: Ancient people believed in a connection between the sky and Earth.
Heavenly bodies were used to tell time and seasons.
Stars and constellations were used as guides for navigation at sea.
Different cultures interpret astronomical phenomena based on their own beliefs.
Ethnoastronomy focuses on cultural understandings of astronomical phenomena.
Dr. Dante L. Ambrosio is considered the father of Philippine ethnoastronomy.
Balatik is a constellation that resembles a hunting trap.
Balatik signaled the start of the kaingin farming period.
Moroporo was a constellation used for navigation and seasonal change.
During a lunar eclipse, Bakunawa was believed to swallow the moon.
Visayans banged drums during lunar eclipses to make Bakunawa release the moon.
